statements.statement: The patient has recurrent transient neurological deficits consistent with a recent transient ischemic attack
The patient has a known personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The patient has concurrent nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was for missing prior authorization
The clinical indication is to evaluate for occult arrhythmias that may be precipitating ischemic events
